# Combobox

> A text input that filters a list of Options as you type, to pick one or, with `multiple`, several as removable tags.

`<slab-combobox>` · Selection · built on `<input role=combobox>`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/combobox/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/combobox.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-combobox label="Language" name="language">
  <slab-option value="en">English</slab-option>
  <slab-option value="es">Spanish</slab-option>
  <slab-option value="fr">French</slab-option>
</slab-combobox>
```

Its Options, and Option Groups, are the same ones [Listbox](listbox.md) uses.

With `multiple`, each selected Option is shown before the input as a tag, a button that removes it. Choosing an Option toggles it and leaves the listbox open for the next one. `values` lists them in the order they were chosen, and each is submitted as its own entry, the way a `<select multiple>` submits them. `removeLabel` names the tags' buttons, "Remove" and the Option's text by default.

With `readonly`, the value can't be changed but the Combobox can still be focused, read and submitted, where `disabled` leaves it out of the form. The listbox doesn't open, the tags are text rather than buttons, and the host is `:state(readonly)`.

## Long lists

For thousands of Options, set `virtual`, as on [Listbox](listbox.md#long-lists). Only the Options in or near view are laid out, filtering and the arrow keys still reach every one, and the listbox scrolls to the selected Option as it opens. Give `::part(listbox)` a maximum block size so it scrolls.

```html
<style>
  slab-combobox::part(listbox) {
    max-block-size: 20rem;
  }
</style>

<slab-combobox label="City" virtual>
  <slab-option>Aachen</slab-option>
  <slab-option>Aalborg</slab-option>
  <!-- And thousands more -->
</slab-combobox>
```

## Keyboard

| Key       | What it does                                                                                    |
| --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Up, Down  | Opens the listbox and moves the active Option, stopping at each end and skipping disabled ones. |
| Alt+Down  | Opens the listbox without moving.                                                               |
| Alt+Up    | Closes the listbox.                                                                             |
| Enter     | Selects the active Option and closes the listbox.                                               |
| Escape    | Closes the listbox, and a second Escape clears the input.                                       |
| Home, End | Move the caret, as in any input.                                                                |

With `multiple`, Enter toggles the active Option and leaves the listbox open, and a second Escape clears only what's typed. These are added:

| Key                             | What it does                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Backspace                       | In an empty input, removes the last tag.                                                        |
| Left                            | At the start of the input, moves to the last tag.                                               |
| Left, Right                     | On a tag, moves to the previous or next one. Right from the last goes back to the input.        |
| Backspace, Delete, Enter, Space | On a tag, removes it and moves to the one that takes its place, or the input when there's none. |
| Escape                          | On a tag, goes back to the input.                                                               |

## Elements

### `<slab-combobox>`

Import `slab-elements/combobox.js` to register it.

A text input that filters a list of Options as it's typed into, with no visual styles. It's the APG's editable combobox with list autocomplete.

Not `<input list>`. A `<datalist>` holds only text, can't be styled, and is drawn differently by every browser, down to whether it filters by prefix or by substring. So this is a real `<input role="combobox">` with a `<div role="listbox">` of slotted Options in a popover beside it.

The listbox is its own rather than a nested Listbox. A Listbox has a label, a Tab stop and a form value of its own, all of which a Combobox would have to switch off. What it shares with Listbox is Option, OptionsController, and the way the active Option is pointed at rather than focused: focus stays in the input, and the input's `aria-activedescendant` is set as an element, since an IDREF can't reach the slotted Options. Read or set it with `activeOption`.

Typing filters the Options by `filter`, a case-insensitive substring of each Option's text unless it's replaced, and opens the listbox. An Option that doesn't match is hidden, so it's out of the accessibility tree and skipped by the arrow keys. With none left, the listbox closes and the host matches `:state(empty)`, for a "no results" message of your own. Screenreaders are told how many Options are left once typing pauses, from `resultsLabel`.

ArrowDown and ArrowUp open the listbox and move the active Option, stopping at each end and skipping disabled Options. Alt with ArrowDown opens it without moving, and Alt with ArrowUp closes it. Enter and a click select the active Option and close the listbox. Escape closes it, and a second Escape clears the input. Home, End and the other caret keys stay the input's. A click or Tab elsewhere closes it, since either takes focus from the input.

`value` is the selected Option's value, not what's in the input, which shows that Option's text. Unless `allow-custom` is set, what's typed has to name an Option: when focus leaves, text that matches one's (ignoring case) selects it, an empty input clears the selection, and anything else goes back to the selected Option's text. With `allow-custom`, text that matches no Option is the value as typed. Either way, `value` is what's submitted, and "input" and "change" are dispatched together when it changes, as on a `<select>`, rather than on every keystroke.

With `multiple`, choosing an Option toggles it and leaves the listbox open, and what's typed is cleared rather than replaced by the Option's text. Each selected value is shown before the input as a tag, a `<button>` that removes it. Backspace in an empty input removes the last, and Left at the start of the input moves focus to the tags, where Left and Right move between them and Backspace, Delete, Enter and Space remove one. In a right-to-left page, Left and Right swap. They aren't Tab stops, so Tab still leaves the Combobox in one press. `values` lists the selected values in the order they were chosen, and each is submitted as its own entry, as a `<select multiple>` submits them. Text that names an Option adds it, and with `allow-custom` so does text that names none.

`readonly` shows the value without letting the user change it: the input can't be typed in, the listbox doesn't open, and the tags are text rather than buttons. It's still focused, read and submitted, where `disabled` leaves it out of the form, and never invalid.

Style it through its parts and through `:state(disabled)`, `:state(empty)`, `:state(error)`, `:state(open)`, `:state(readonly)` and `:state(required)`, and each Option through `:state(active)`, `:state(disabled)` and `:state(selected)`. The tags are `::part(tag)`, in `::part(tags)`.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type                | Default    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------- | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`            |            | Names it. It's the accessible name, and the visible label where there is one.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `allow-custom`     | `boolean`           | `false`    | Lets the value be text that matches no Option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `disabled`         | `boolean`           | `false`    | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `hide-label`       | `boolean`           | `false`    | Hides the label visually and leaves it as the accessible name, for a design that shows the label some other way.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `multiple`         | `boolean`           | `false`    | Lets more than one Option be selected, each shown as a tag that removes it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `name`             | `string`            | `''`       | The name its value is submitted under, as a native control's `name`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `open`             | `boolean`           | `false`    | Whether it's open. Set it to open or close it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `placeholder`      | `string`            |            | Shown while it's empty, as a native input's `placeholder`. It's a hint, not a label.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `readonly`         | `boolean`           | `false`    | Shows the value without letting the user change it. The listbox doesn't open and the tags can't be removed. It's still focusable and submitted, and never invalid, as a native read-only input isn't.                                                                                                            |
| `placement`        | `'bottom' \| 'top'` | `'bottom'` | The side of the input the listbox opens on, when there's room. It flips when there isn't.                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `required`         | `boolean`           | `false`    | Makes it invalid while it has no value, as `required` does a native control.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `virtual`          | `boolean`           | `false`    | Lays out only the Options in or near view, for a Combobox with thousands. Give `::part(listbox)` a maximum block size so it scrolls. Options are taken to be the same height as each other.                                                                                                                      |
| `value`            | `string`            | `''`       | The selected Option's value, or the typed text when `allow-custom` is set and it matches no Option. The first of `values` when `multiple` is set. Setting it selects the Option with that value, and only that one. Like a native input, the attribute is the default value and the property is the current one. |

#### Properties

| Name                            | Type                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `filter`                        | `(option: Option, query: string) => boolean` | Whether an Option matches what's been typed. A case-insensitive substring of its text by default.                                                                                       |
| `removeLabel`                   | `(text: string) => string`                   | Names each tag's button, which shows only the selected Option's text, from that text. "Remove" and the text in English when unset.                                                      |
| `removedLabel`                  | `(text: string) => string`                   | What screenreaders are told when a tag is removed, from its text. The text and "removed" in English when unset.                                                                         |
| `resultsLabel`                  | `(count: number) => string`                  | What screenreaders are told once typing pauses, from how many Options are left. "No results", "1 result" and so on in English when unset.                                               |
| `values`                        | `string[]`                                   | Every selected value, in the order they were chosen. Only the first when `multiple` isn't set. Setting it selects the Options with those values, and only those.                        |
| `defaultValue`                  | `string`                                     | The value it selects when none of its Options has `selected`, and goes back to when its form resets. It's the `value` attribute, so setting it sets the attribute, and `value` with it. |
| `activeOption`                  | `Option \| null`                             | The Option the user is on, which Enter selects. It's pointed at rather than focused, so focus stays in the input.                                                                       |
| `form` (read-only)              | `HTMLFormElement \| null`                    | The form it belongs to, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                      |
| `options` (read-only)           | `Option[]`                                   | Its Options, in order.                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `selectedOption` (read-only)    | `Option \| null`                             | The first selected Option, or `null`.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `selectedOptions` (read-only)   | `Option[]`                                   | The Options of `values`, in the same order. Values that name no Option are left out.                                                                                                    |
| `validationMessage` (read-only) | `string`                                     | What's wrong, as the validity message says it: the message given to `setCustomValidity()` or `setValidity()`, or else the browser's own. Empty while it's valid.                        |
| `validity` (read-only)          | `ValidityState`                              | Its `ValidityState`, as a native control's.                                                                                                                                             |
| `willValidate` (read-only)      | `boolean`                                    | Whether its validity is checked when its form submits. It isn't while it's disabled or read-only.                                                                                       |

#### Methods

| Signature                                                         | Description                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `checkValidity(): boolean`                                        | Whether its value is valid. Dispatches "invalid" when it isn't, as a native control's does.                                                                                        |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`                             | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus.                                                                                                                                    |
| `hide(): void`                                                    | Closes the listbox.                                                                                                                                                                |
| `reportValidity(): boolean`                                       | Whether its value is valid. When it isn't, dispatches "invalid" and shows the validity message, as a native control's does.                                                        |
| `resetValidityFeedback(): void`                                   | Clears the validity feedback without changing `validity`.                                                                                                                          |
| `setCustomValidity(message: string): void`                        | Makes it invalid with a message of your own, or valid again with an empty one, as a native control's does.                                                                         |
| `setValidity(flags?: ValidityStateFlags, message?: string): void` | Sets its validity and message, as `ElementInternals.setValidity()` does, for checks of your own beyond `setCustomValidity()`.                                                      |
| `show(): void`                                                    | Opens the listbox, unless there's nothing in it to choose: while it's disabled, or when no Option matches what's typed.                                                            |
| `toggle(force?: boolean): boolean`                                | Opens it when it's closed, and closes it when it's open, as a native popover's `togglePopover()` does. `true` only opens it and `false` only closes it. Returns whether it's open. |

#### Events

| Name           | Type          | Description                                                                                                          |
| -------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `toggle`       | `ToggleEvent` | When it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` with `oldState` and `newState` that doesn't bubble, as a popover's does. |
| `input`        | `Event`       | As the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.                 |
| `change`       | `Event`       | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it.               |
| `invalid`      | `Event`       | When a check finds its value invalid, as a native control's does. Cancel it to leave the validity message unshown.   |
| `beforetoggle` | `ToggleEvent` | Before it opens or closes, as a `ToggleEvent` that doesn't bubble. Cancel it while it's opening to keep it closed.   |

#### Slots

| Name          | Type                    | Description                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default)     | `Option \| OptionGroup` |                                                                                                             |
| `description` | `Element \| string`     | Text that describes it, such as a hint or what the validity message means. It's its accessible description. |

#### CSS parts

| Name               | Description                                                       |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `description`      | Text about the Combobox, and its validity message when it has one |
| `input`            | The input                                                         |
| `label`            | The label                                                         |
| `listbox`          | The Options, in a popover beside the input                        |
| `tag`              | A selected value's button, which removes it                       |
| `tags`             | The tags                                                          |
| `validity-message` | The validity message, which says why the value is invalid         |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                                               |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                                                      |
| `:state(empty)`    | While no option matches what the user typed, for a "no results" message of your own.                                      |
| `:state(error)`    | While it's invalid and its validity message shows, which is once its validity is reported, as when its form is submitted. |
| `:state(open)`     | While it's open.                                                                                                          |
| `:state(readonly)` | While it's read-only.                                                                                                     |
| `:state(required)` | While it's required, for styles such as an asterisk.                                                                      |
